targets.title: Sunk-cost effects on purely behavioral investments
targets.evidence_quote:
In an effort to extend these results, we first tried to replicate Cunha and Caldieraro’s
(2009) first experiment utilizing undergraduates at the University of Texas at Austin using
identical stimuli and instructions.
targets.outcome_quote:
I have been unable to replicate their pattern of results
in three separate investigations.

reasoning: Three new experiments retest Experiment 1 of Cunha and Caldieraro, using their original manipulation and two extensions. The author explicitly states an overall failure to replicate. A successful effort manipulation does not change the main verdict.
